text: Nursery, academic session 2027-2028: children born on or between 2 April 2023 and 1 April 2024 are eligible.

topic: Admission criteria, total number of seats, seat distribution and EWS reservation
text:
Criteria for admission (Nursery seats):
Total number of seats: 120.
Seat distribution by category:
- General Category: 100 seats
- Transfer Cases: 8 seats
- Wards of the Teachers: 8 seats
- Children/Grandchildren of the Members of the Governing Council and Nehru Sidhant Kender Trust: 4 seats
- Total: 120 seats
25% of the seats are reserved for the EWS (Economically Weaker Section) category.

topic: Merit criteria, points system and marks for admission (neighbourhood, sibling, first born, alumni, parents' qualification)
text:
The admission process is designed to provide equal opportunity to all and maintain transparency. The merit of applicants is determined on the basis of the following points criteria:
- Neighbourhood: 0-10 km from the school = 10 points; above 10 km = 5 points (maximum 10)
- Sibling: 40 points
- First Born: 15 points
- Non-Sibling: 15 points
- Ward of Single Parent / Orphan / Adopted Child: 5 points
- Ward/Sibling of Alumni of Oxford55 School: 5 points
- Qualification of the Parents: 10 points

Break-up of marks for the qualification of the parents:
- Ph.D. / Doctorate / DM: 5
- Post Graduate and Graduate: 4
- Minimum 2 years Diploma (after Grade XII): 3
- Others: 2

topic: Tie-break lottery (draw of lots) and waiting list
text:
Same score (tie): if candidates get the same score, a draw of lots is conducted among the candidates with that score. The lottery is held when the number of candidates with the same points is more than the remaining vacancies in the general list of 100. It is organised in the presence of the parents of the shortlisted candidates, and the lots are drawn by a parent or child. The entire process is videographed.

Waiting list: apart from the 100 seats in the General Category, a list of the next 5 students forms the Waiting List. It is put up along with the selected list of 100 students in the General Category and is valid for 30 days from the declaration of the final list.

topic: Verification of documents, false documents and final decision of the school
text:
The management reserves the right to check the authenticity of all documents with the issuing authorities (for example, qualification certificates from the issuing university). If at any stage, even after admission, any document is found to be false or fake, the application/admission stands cancelled and the matter is reported to the relevant legal authorities for further action.
The decision of the school is final and binding.

topic: Admission dates, registration schedule and payment
text: Online registration for the 2027-2028 session opens on 9 September 2026 and closes on 13 September 2026. Registration forms can be filled online only. Payment is made online by debit card, credit card or net banking.

topic: Submission of hard copy of registration form and documents, dates, timings and cut-off list date
text:
Submission of the hard copy of the registration form along with prescribed documents in the school: Thursday, 10th September, 2026 to Monday, 14th September, 2026, from 9.00 am to 2.00 pm (as per the time slots allotted to you).
List showing the cut off points of shortlisted candidates will be put up on the school notice board as well as the school website: Wednesday, 16th September, 2026.
PLEASE DO NOT WAIT FOR THE LAST DATES. YOU ARE ADVISED TO COMPLETE EVERYTHING AT LEAST ONE DAY EARLIER.

Documents to submit with the registration form:
1. A hard copy of the registration form with recent passport-size photographs of the parents and the child.
2. A self-attested photocopy of the birth certificate, with the original for verification.
3. Proof of residence: a photocopy of any one of Electoral Card, Passport, Driving License, Aadhaar Card, or a rent deed attested by an executive magistrate, AND copies of electricity, telephone or gas connection bills for the last six months (any one type). Change of address is not allowed until 6 months after the start of the academic session.
4. Proof of the parents' highest educational qualification. If the highest qualification is a 2-year diploma, also attach a copy of the Grade XII passing certificate along with the diploma certificate.
5. A printout of the Google Map showing the distance from the applicant's residence to Oxford55 School. The school may verify the distance and address.
All certificates must be self-attested and the originals brought for verification. Incorrect or incomplete forms will be rejected. Read the instructions carefully before filling the form; the school does not entertain telephonic or other communication on these instructions.

topic: Documents required for special categories (staff child, sibling, government transfer, first-born, adopted, orphan, single parent)
text:
Extra documents depending on the applicant's category:
- Child of school staff: a copy of the staff ID card.
- Sibling studying at Oxford55 School: a copy of the sibling's ID card.
- Ward of a government employee or officer freshly transferred to Ludhiana (between 9 September 2026, the start of registration, and 1 April 2027, the start of the academic year): a letter of service from the department and a copy of the government job ID.
- First-born child: an affidavit confirming the child is the first-born. Parents must download the affidavit format provided by the school.
- Adopted child: a copy of the registered adoption deed.
- Orphan: copies of the parents' death certificates along with proof of guardianship.
- Single parent: only the qualification of the parent with custody is considered. Divorcee: divorce decree. Widow/widower: death certificate of the spouse. These legal documents must clearly mention the name of the custodian and the name of the child.
Warning: do not trust vendors who claim to be appointed by Oxford55 School to fill forms or make affidavits or other documents. The school has not authorised any outside agency for documentation or the admission process. Contact the school directly in case of doubt.

Alumni conditions:
1. The alumnus/alumna must have cleared ISC (Grade 12) from Oxford55 School.
2. They must have studied in the school for a minimum of 4 consecutive years.
Alumni must also submit a copy of the Transfer Certificate issued by Oxford55 School.

Registration process:
- Forms for children born on or between 2 April 2023 and 1 April 2024 can be filled online only, for the 2027-2028 session.
- Read the registration page completely, then click the button at the bottom of the page to open the registration form. Pay online by debit card, credit card or net banking.
- You will be allotted a time slot to submit your registration form. After payment you will receive an SMS with the registration number and the date and time. Your application will not be considered if you do not come for verification and submission at the allotted date and time. Make sure DND (Do Not Disturb) is deactivated on your mobile number so the OTP is received.
- You will also get an email listing the required documents, with a copy of your filled registration form. For a single parent, fill in the details of only one parent/guardian. Keep this email as a record of your application status and check the Spam folder if it does not arrive in your inbox.
- Submit the hard copy of the registration form with the required documents at the School Reception Counter. Write the registration number on all documents. Only one parent per candidate is allowed for the submission.
Fee details are not available in this chatbot. Please contact the admissions office for the current fee structure.
